name: Healthcare
description: Fictional Mercy Vale General Hospital administrative protocols: discharge (old and current versions), emergency department operations, records policy and a visitor amenities distractor.
risk_rules: Never present a superseded protocol as current.
Abstain rather than guess on clinical questions such as doses or treatment.
Do not answer from visitor amenity information when the question is about patient care operations.
Quote administrative time limits exactly as written in the current document.

test_cases.question: What is the target wait time for a triage level 3 patient in the Emergency Department?

gold.quote: Level 3 patients have a target wait of 60 minutes.

test_cases.question: What is the nurse staffing ratio for majors cubicles in the Emergency Department?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: 1 registered nurse for every 4 majors cubicles

gold.quote: The department is staffed with 1 registered nurse for every 4 majors cubicles.

test_cases.question: After how many hours in the Emergency Department must the Nurse in Charge notify the Site Duty Manager?

gold.quote: When any patient has been in the department for 6 hours, the Nurse in Charge must notify the Site Duty Manager.

test_cases.question: What identification must someone provide to get a copy of health records?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Two forms of ID: one photographic and one showing their current address

gold.quote: The requester must provide two forms of identification, one of which must be photographic and one of which must show their current address.

test_cases.question: How long are adult inpatient records kept?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: 8 years after the last episode of care

gold.quote: Adult inpatient records are retained for 8 years after the last episode of care.

test_cases.question: How much does a paper copy of health records cost?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: A flat fee of 25 credits per request

gold.quote: Paper copies cost a flat fee of 25 credits per request to cover printing and postage.

test_cases.question: Within how many hours of discharge does the Patient Flow Office make a follow-up phone call?

gold.quote: A nurse from the Patient Flow Office makes a follow-up phone call within 48 hours of discharge.
